selection_policy: source house then pair ID, up to ten per family, one house per family; no model outcomes
limitations: Existing validation houses were reused for instrument development, including prior frozen-model diagnostics. This is a development benchmark, not an untouched generalization test.
L and L+D are low-light strata. Synthetic room-local attenuation can be bypassed by some outside-room views; mandatory lighting actions and zero information in initial RGB are not established.
N controls use derived shared readable-start poses from existing scenes, and STATE is a separate query axis. Neither enters the equal-family CHECK macro.
D+door has only three currently valid existing-source pairs; uncertainty is large. O is excluded and L+C/C+C are absent from the historical source pool.

Task inclusion uses visual semantic review and legal oracle replay, never evaluated-model scores. Fixed routes, masks and timeouts alone are not invalidity criteria. Review is assistant visual inspection, not independent blinded multi-rater annotation.
Two initial pixel-difference flags overlap within-world renderer variance on repeat checks. These limited tests do not establish absence of every visual or feedback side channel.

Policy receives current RGB plus textual action/result history, without previous-image memory, under the inspection-v4-dev query-object-reference restriction and uniform hidden budget. This is one specified policy protocol, not a bound on model capability.
Greedy start-frame, oracle-witness-frame and interactive evaluations are reported separately. Pair correctness alone does not certify evidence acquisition; geometric evidence fields remain proxies.
The same house can appear in different families. There is one house per pair within each family; pairs across families are not statistically independent.
No teacher model, training, SFT, new houses, or old-paper thesis validation is part of this run.
